beginner.summary: For developers, testers, team leads and operations engineers who are new to Azure DevOps Services. Covers organisations, projects, access levels and permissions, Azure Boards work items, backlogs, sprints and queries, Azure Repos with pull requests and branch policies, a first YAML pipeline with triggers, variables, tests and artifacts, Microsoft-hosted agents, Azure Artifacts feeds, a first workload identity federation service connection, an App Service deployment, Azure Test Plans, wikis and dashboards, and a capstone that takes one team project from backlog to a running web app.
prerequisites: Uses Git from the command line: clone, branch, commit, push and pull
Has built and tested a small application in a language such as C#, Java, Python or JavaScript
Has a Microsoft Entra ID or Microsoft account, an Azure subscription with Contributor rights on a resource group, and the Azure CLI installed
outcomes: Create an Azure DevOps organisation and project and give each team member the right access level and security group
Plan work in Azure Boards with work items, backlogs, sprints, boards and WIQL queries
Protect a main branch in Azure Repos with pull requests, reviewers and build validation
Write a YAML pipeline that builds, tests, publishes artifacts and deploys to Azure App Service through a workload identity federation service connection
